replacement.title: Revenue and Demand Forecast
replacement.definition: Models site-level demand and the resulting revenue streams using the supplied demand analysis, corridor traffic information, indicative pricing, and explicit driver assumptions.

patches.decision_note: Demand, traffic, pricing, and revenue drivers form an independently testable forecasting mechanism not represented by the capex, opex, financing, or availability-payment Requirements.

replacement.title: Tax and CCA Depreciation Model
replacement.definition: Models taxes and depreciation using applicable Canadian Capital Cost Allowance classes so the tax shield and resulting equity returns are credible.

patches.decision_note: The client explicitly requires proper asset-class CCA modeling, which can change independently from the capital stack and materially affects the tax shield and equity returns.

replacement.title: Model Currency and Base Year
replacement.definition: Uses Canadian dollars and a 2026 base year as the model-wide monetary and temporal basis.

patches.decision_note: The source establishes explicit model-wide configuration constraints absent from the current inventory; its short lifecycle should not be broadened merely to satisfy dataset eligibility.
This source establishes the numerical availability-payment justification already owned by REQ_AVAILABILITY_PAYMENT_JUSTIFICATION, not the distinct investment-story behavior.

value_updates.investment_story: Clearly demonstrate that the project is financially viable, bankable, and attractive to investors rather than presenting calculations without decision-oriented interpretation.

patches.decision_note: Message 36 first establishes the independently stated investment-story behavior and should introduce it before recording the observed failure.

execution.observed_behavior: The client reports that the delivered model focuses on calculations rather than telling the required investment story.

patches.decision_note: The same source concretely reports that the delivered model fails the newly stated investment-narrative behavior; it does not separately modify that behavior.
The supplied evidence does not safely establish whether the short presentation became an independently accepted deliverable or remained an implementation approach for model clarity.
